definitions.gloss: a help, some assistance, small contribution
definitions.explanation: A modest but meaningful contribution or aid toward achieving something. Implies that the help is one part of a larger effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{一助|いちじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれば→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧です。
examples.english: I would be glad if this could be of some help.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}{解決|かいけつ}→問題解決：26071_mondaikaiketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一助|いちじょ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧。
examples.english: I hope this research will contribute to solving the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{活性化|かっせいか}→活性化：07563_kasseika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一助|いちじょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I participated in volunteer activities as a contribution to revitalizing the local community.

notes:
{一助|いちじょ} refers to a modest but meaningful contribution toward a larger goal. It implies that one's help is just one part of a broader effort.

WRITING:
⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ (one) + {助|じょ} (help, assistance). Literally "one help" — emphasizing the humility of the contribution.

REGISTER:
A formal, written-style word commonly found in academic papers, speeches, and business correspondence. It conveys modesty about one's own contribution.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一助|いちじょ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as a help for ~
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一助|いちじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれば→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧です: I would be glad if this helps with ~
- {一助|いちじょ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as a (small) contribution

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{助|たす}け→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧: help (general, everyday)
- ⟦{貢献|こうけん}→貢献：02737_kouken⟧: contribution (more substantial, less modest)
